scripts.generate:api: npm run generate:openapi && openapi-typescript docs/contracts/openapi.json -o apps/web/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.check:api-drift: npm run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- docs/contracts/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run test:forecasting
scripts.dev:api: SMARTSTOCK_INVENTORY_BACKEND=postgres SMARTSTOCK_AUTH_MODE=development SMARTSTOCK_DATABASE_URL="postgresql+psycopg://smartstock:smartstock@127.0.0.1:5432/smartstock" PYTHONPATH=apps/api python3 -m uvicorn smartstock_api.main:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:all: scripts/devstack.sh start && (npm run dev:api & npm run dev)
